node.label: ASAH1-related sphingolipidosis
node.definition: A spectrum of disorders caused by variation(s) in the ASAH1 genel this spectrum includes Farber disease and spinal muscular atrophy with progressive myoclonic epilepsy. The ASAH1 gene encodes the lysosomal hydrolase that breaks down the bioactive lipid, ceramide.

children_labels.MONDO:0008045: spinal muscular atrophy-progressive myoclonic epilepsy syndrome

mechanism_classes.label: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails)
